agent_explanation: Controller uses very small forces (<1N vs 44N limit) to keep pole near upright (theta ~ -0.08 rad, margin ~0.71) but allows cart position to drift left monotonic: x -0.24 -> -1.91 at step 200 (v -1.09) -> -2.347 at step 220 -> -2.419 at step 223. No pushes/noise. Feedback gains for this plant (cart_mass 0.65kg, pole_length 0.87m) do not sufficiently penalize cart position, so cart exits track while pole remains upright.
